cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your tea, exactly as you like it. Someone remembers preferences.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you for remembering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome. The department never closed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we talking about my forgetting your birthday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Your tea would get cold during that annual discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 remembers B's tea while needling forgetfulness; A5 protects the tea while reviving the birthday grievance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 thanks A for remembering, prompting A3's ongoing-service claim; B4 names the birthday, enabling A5's annual jab.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers genuine thanks and B4 recognizes the shared grievance rather than merely feeding a joke.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's single forgotten birthday into an 'annual discussion' while maintaining the caring pretext.

specificity.evidence: A1's preferred tea and B4's forgotten birthday establish a readily playable domestic history.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 joins keeping tea warm to the duration of the grievance; A3's department metaphor is slightly conspicuous.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 couples tea and 'love' with a forgotten birthday; A3 warms a plate while exposing the delay; A5 shields the flame while recalling the curtailed call.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's late cake prompts A3's plate and saved candle; B4's offer to sing prompts A5's protection against another interrupted birthday observance.

relationship.evidence: B2 brings a belated repair and B4 volunteers to sing; A3 and A5 accept that affection while keeping the grievances active.

heightening.evidence: B4 offers immediate repair; A5 turns helping that repair succeed into a reminder that the neglect extends to last year.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes intimate tea service; B2 supplies a month-late cake, and A3's saved candle gives actors a concrete shared birthday ritual.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Your favourite, too' economically adds another grievance; A5's flame comparison earns its sting but spells out the parallel.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies the overdue cake; A3 responds with plate warming, its flavour, and the candle retained through the delay.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 agrees to the candle and offers to sing; A5 draws B closer and protects the flame while invoking an earlier interrupted celebration.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 each make sincere care carry a pointed reminder of neglect.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 uses B4's conciliatory birthday ritual to reveal a longer history of disappointment without withdrawing warmth.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A continues familiar care while using that care to deliver an old grievance indirectly.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A purely hostile sarcastic attack would dispense with the real attention to B's comfort.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 supplies tea exactly to B's preference; A5 keeps concern for its temperature wrapped around birthday resentment.

The revision keeps birthday hospitality and introduces B's belated cake and offer to sing. records.remainingConcern: A3 leaves the cake's flavour implicit, and A5's explicit comparison is slightly polished. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: A3's reference to B's favourite cake carries an understated extra grievance. A5 introduces another birthday injury; affectionate proximity must keep this from becoming a list of accusations.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative uses reciprocal physical care and a pickup grievance; this candidate tests a belated birthday repair against accumulated neglect.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're charging rent on closeness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very modest calendar-based rate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we start with coffee?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Coffee earns a provisional key discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices a spare key in monthly visits; A5 assigns coffee a smaller relational return.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 accepts B2's rent framing; A5 recalculates access around B4's coffee counteroffer.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges the price and B4 proposes a lower-commitment way to reconnect.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends the ledger to charging for a discussion before the key itself.

specificity.evidence: A1's spare key 'again' and Sunday schedule imply a concrete history of withdrawn access.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'provisional key discussion' is a precise smaller purchase in response to B4's coffee.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices renewed key access in visits; A3 prices hallway access in lunch; A5 exchanges practical support for additional companionship.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's Sunday work and belongings change A3's terms to Saturday and room access; B4's lunch offer purchases records in A5 and creates a further bargain.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants possessions and has a work constraint; B4 negotiates through a shared meal, exposing A5's wish to prolong their time together.

heightening.evidence: After B4 meets the lunch price, A5 makes listening together the price of help carrying boxes, extending the transaction into departure.

specificity.evidence: A1's spare key and B2's collection visit establish strained access; A3's hallway and records make the bargaining immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Saturday lunch buys the hallway' compresses the game; A5's record-listening condition reveals the emotional motive without explaining it.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 cannot visit Sundays and needs belongings; A3 substitutes Saturday and divides access by room.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers lunch for both; A5 credits that payment toward the records and offers carrying help for staying longer.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently assign relational and practical benefits explicit interpersonal prices.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 accepts the negotiated payment but opens another companionship transaction around the imminent departure.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A turns renewed closeness and household access into a graduated exchange for reliable attention.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Setting a reliability boundary could explain A1, but charging coffee for a preliminary discussion creates a relational price schedule.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 endorses the 'rate' and A5 assigns coffee a specific lesser entitlement.

records.recommendedEdit: The supplied review rejected the candidate's weak personal stake and administrative finish; the original firstPass is preserved. The revised key setting adds collecting belongings and working Sundays. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5 (A3 prices room access and A5 prices carrying help in shared listening), logic 5 (B2's shift and collection need generate Saturday and room pricing; B4's supplied lunch buys records and prompts another offer), relationship 4 (B2 needs belongings and B4 offers a feasible shared meal), heightening 4 (A5 adds support purchased through listening together), specificity 5 (A1's key, A3's rooms and A5's record boxes locate the negotiation), brevityWit 4 (A3's hallway price concretizes the ledger and A5 extends it): 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 74 words; B can negotiate the listening offer.
records.remainingConcern: The relationship is unspecified, and withholding belongings can make A controlling; the bargaining remains clear and playable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: Charging access to B's belongings gives A a controlling edge. A5's offer to help should reveal sincere hunger for shared time, without treating B's acceptance as predetermined.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 asks B to remove one burden instead of answering what's wrong; A5 permits support without naming its weight.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 redirects B2's inquiry toward the call; A5 conditionally accepts B4's offer to talk afterward.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks understanding, then B4 offers a gentler sequence rather than demanding disclosure.

heightening.evidence: A5 opens the possibility of further emotional support after the initial practical delegation.

specificity.evidence: A1 gives B a concrete cancellation call, though the booking's emotional significance remains withheld.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'one thing lighter' develops A3's 'take off me' without explaining the underlying crisis.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 delegates a painful cancellation; A3 requests relief without answering what happened; A5 asks for company and ordinary conversation during another difficult task.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's inquiry prompts A3 to substitute practical help for disclosure; B4's rescheduling question receives A5's 'Say no for me' before a further request.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks understanding and B4 accepts the call while anticipating its requirements; A5 trusts B with both an answer and continued presence.

heightening.evidence: B4's possible new date prompts A5 to reject postponement and seek company while putting anniversary glasses away, making the loss more tangible.

specificity.evidence: A1 provides the restaurant number on the fridge and A5 provides anniversary glasses, although 'our anniversary' leaves B's relationship to the loss uncertain.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'first thing you take off me' carries the emotional request economically; A5's ordinary-day conversation preserves the avoidance without a detachable joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks what happened; A3 redirects that inquiry toward removing one burden without naming the underlying distress.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 raises rescheduling; A5 supplies the refusal and turns the cancellation into a request for companionship during the associated packing away.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 obtain practical and emotional support while withholding an account of how heavy the situation has become.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from having B handle a call to having B remain through a personally painful ritual.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A recruits practical help as a share of emotional weight while avoiding a declaration of how overwhelmed they are.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Start the Hard Part delegates a difficult beginning; this exchange also negotiates ongoing support without requiring disclosure.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 asks for the call before answering B2's inquiry, and A5 leaves further talking conditional on the relief it creates.

records.recommendedEdit: The supplied review rejected the candidate's tentative A5 and generic occasion; the original firstPass remains preserved. The new illustrative setting specifies an anniversary booking and its glasses while leaving the rupture unexplained. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5 (A3 defers disclosure and A5 recruits company without explaining distress), logic 5 (B2's inquiry prompts A3's prioritization; B4's replacement-date question prompts A5's delegated refusal and putting anniversary objects away), relationship 4 (B2 seeks understanding and B4 accepts the task while anticipating a practical question), heightening 4 (A5 expands a call into representing A's refusal and staying through a domestic aftermath), specificity 4 (A1 locates the number and occasion; A5 supplies the glasses), brevityWit 3 (A5's ordinary-day request is economical but primarily tender): 86. Five spoken ABABA turns, 66 words; neither disclosure nor successful relief is forced.
records.remainingConcern: The referent of 'our anniversary' and B's knowledge require actor interpretation. The practical-to-emotional progression supports a pass without rewriting.
records.writerReservation: The anniversary's fate and B's relationship to A remain unspecified. A5 gives a concrete next burden, but the scene still depends more on guarded vulnerability than comic surprise.
records.alternativeComparison: This candidate delegates a cancellation and then seeks ordinary company; the preserved alternative shares an unfolding letter through controlled pace and physical attention.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for one more tea. My hands haven't caught up with the news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the fourth needs no explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me manage one quiet minute while it's still only outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 links staying to unsteady hands after news; A5 asks for one manageable minute before B leaves.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's three cups to normalize a fourth; A5 reduces the request when B4 announces the taxi.

relationship.evidence: B2 registers the extended stay and B4 supplies a real departure constraint.

heightening.evidence: A5 drops the tea pretext and makes B's imminent departure the explicit pressure on becoming steady.

specificity.evidence: A1's hands and tea provide physical anchors; B4's taxi makes departure immediate.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's fourth-cup logic grows from B2; A5's 'still only outside' precisely locates the remaining reprieve.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks B to stay until A can tell the children; A3 substitutes rehearsal for tea; A5 requests a final supported attempt before speaking alone.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's three cups cause A3 to abandon the kettle; B4's waiting taxi causes A5 to request two minutes and one specific rehearsal sentence.

relationship.evidence: B2 signals that the visit has already stretched and B4 introduces an actual departure constraint; A3 and A5 adapt their requests.

heightening.evidence: Under B4's taxi pressure, A5 stops extending hospitality and attempts the exact hospital announcement with a concrete emotional hurdle.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes tomorrow's operation and the waiting conversation with the children; A5 supplies 'I'll be in hospital' as immediately playable rehearsal.

brevityWit.evidence: B2's 'three cups' economically exposes the delaying tactic; A3's 'skip the kettle' changes tactics cleanly, while A5 is somewhat more explanatory.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals repeated tea delays; A3 drops that excuse and directly requests rehearsal.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 makes departure imminent; A5 bargains for a short delay and narrows the support needed to saying one sentence.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 through A5 pursue continued presence specifically as preparation for facing the children without B.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns indefinite staying into a pressured, concrete test of steadiness; 'I'll try' leaves the outcome open.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A extends B's physical presence in progressively more direct bids for enough steadiness to endure the departure.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Wanting company indefinitely lacks the card's readiness threshold; A asks for a manageable interval tied to immediate distress.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 names unsteady hands after news, and A5 asks to manage one quiet minute as B4's taxi threatens departure.

records.recommendedEdit: The supplied review rejected the candidate's vague readiness process; the original firstPass remains preserved. The new illustrative setting is a parent preparing to tell children about an operation. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 keep B present for practice before A speaks alone), logic 5 (B2's three cups cause A3 to drop tea; B4's taxi causes A5 to request two minutes for one specific sentence), relationship 4 (B2 flags delay and B4 supplies a credible departure limit), heightening 4 (A5 moves from proposing rehearsal to naming the difficult sentence and the apology habit to overcome), specificity 5 (A1 establishes tomorrow's operation and the children; A5 identifies the immediate speaking task), brevityWit 3 (A3's skipped kettle is economical, while A5 principally earns emotional clarity): 90. Five spoken ABABA turns, 68 words; 'try' leaves readiness and the next interaction unresolved.
records.remainingConcern: A5 introduces apologising as a second emotional hurdle alongside crying, and B's role is principally departure pressure. No rewrite needed.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting. Tell me that counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could do more next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before next month, could this one be enough for today?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You worked hard on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Let me hear that without an assignment afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks whether one painting counts; A3 asks for present sufficiency rather than future productivity.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's next-month suggestion; A5 takes B4's praise and asks to preserve it without another assignment.

relationship.evidence: B2 initially motivates through improvement, then B4 changes to recognizing effort.

heightening.evidence: A5 specifies that reassurance must stand alone, building on B4's partial recognition.

specificity.evidence: A1 gives one finished painting and B2 supplies the competing monthly productivity frame.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'assignment afterward' compresses A's concern about B2's advice into a concrete final condition.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly asks whether one painting is enough; A3 rejects concealment as reassurance; A5 seeks public recognition, with a slight shift toward belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's plan to hide the gap causes A3's distinction between contribution and concealment; B4's central placement causes A5 to request an equal introduction.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to solve their shared exhibition problem and B4 then affirms A's work through prominence; A3 and A5 clarify what kind of support is needed.

heightening.evidence: B4 makes A's painting the first viewers will see; A5 extends that visible endorsement into a public introduction without mitigating language.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a shared exhibition with one completed painting; B2's spacing and B4's central placement make the practical and emotional stakes concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 precisely exposes why hiding a gap is inadequate reassurance; A5's 'No despite everything' efficiently identifies the unwanted qualification.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers concealment of missing work; A3 explicitly asks for reassurance that the existing contribution counts.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers the painting pride of place; A5 asks B to make that endorsement audible by introducing A as the other painter.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 and A3 establish sufficiency as the need, making A5's request for an unqualified introduction a concrete form of reassurance.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from private reassurance to public affirmation in response to B4's proposed public prominence.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A seeks reassurance that the completed effort is sufficient without making it a prelude to further demands.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Seeking praise for quality would ask whether the painting is good; A asks whether doing this much is enough.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 explicitly asks for one painting to be 'enough for today', and A5 excludes an added assignment.

The new illustrative setting is a shared exhibition with B as the other painter. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5 (A1 asks for enoughness and A3 seeks acknowledgment of contribution), logic 5 (B2's gap-covering solution prompts A3's concern about being hidden; B4's central placement prompts A5's request for matching public standing), relationship 4 (B2 offers practical help and B4 shifts to valuing A's contribution), heightening 4 (A5 makes reassurance consequential through an unqualified introduction as a fellow painter), specificity 5 (A1's exhibition and B4's placement give the actors a concrete shared undertaking), brevityWit 4 (A3's hiding distinction and A5's excluded qualification expose the reassurance sought economically): 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 75 words; B remains free to respond to the introduction request.
records.remainingConcern: A5 edges toward a belonging drive, and 'despite everything' implies unsupplied hardship. The established contribution question keeps it sufficiently anchored; no rewrite needed.
